$comment: The last recorded CRE workflow simulation, in machine-readable form, so /bond renders the real
run rather than a hard-coded string. Item 8.1 regenerates this file from a fresh capture and the
lib/cre-sim.ts validator refuses a mangled paste, so a bad edit fails at build and test rather
than rendering an undefined count as a number.
Every value here is quoted from a real run, never invented. featured is Run A (agent 10182,
observation mode, the 238 bps output), captured 2026-09-22 when the workflow was first built and
simulated against live Monad mainnet. bondRead is Run B (agent 10256), the chain half reading a
real deployed bond's terms, transcript in docs/26-CRE-SIMULATION.md dated 2026-09-25. No single
run shows a full slash because no agent has both a bond and a decided sample, which is by design.
